card.title: IPhone XR No display. Phone boots but without image

source.title: IPhone XR No display. Phone boots but without image

claims.statement: iPhone XR no image: after the screen and pry damage, a short on the 5V7 line (caps mostly beside the NAND on the back) is the fixable case.
C5600 on PP_CHESNUT_CP has no ground leg; continuity across it means replace it.

Commonly the fault is cracked traces under the CPU from drops (often the CPU shield broken near the Wi-Fi IC); replacing Chestnut only helps temporarily. Clamping the CPU can give image for a data backup.

procedure: Rule out screen and pry damage.
Check C5600 for continuity across it.
For CPU-related cases, treat as data recovery.
